faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by VCSG Uttarakhand University of Horticulture & Forestry (UUHF) for the post of Dean, College of Horticulture based in Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post of Dean, College of Horticulture under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Doctorate Degree in the subject concerned or relevant basic science along with 15 years of teaching, research, or extension experience in a reputed organization.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary structure for the Dean position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary as per Pay Matrix Level-14, ranging from Rs. 1,44,200 to Rs. 2,18,200 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of the filled offline application form is 19 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must download the form, fill it, attach documents, and send it via speed or registered post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General and SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1200/- for General/UR category candidates and Rs. 600/- for SC/ST category candidates, payable via Demand Draft.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The superannuation age in the University is 65 years, which serves as the maximum age limit for applicants seeking this position.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected for this position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves two main stages: screening of the received applications followed by a personal interview of shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form must be sent by speed or registered post to the Chief Personnel Officer at Research & Extension Center (REC), VCSG UUHF, Dehradun.
